collection_contract.online_insert_rule: insert empty slot; replace only on strictly higher best_score
collection_contract.retrieval_rule: top-k semantic similarity over risk category and behavior

collection_flow: start episode with behavior and optional top-k memory retrieval
issue one or more target queries and observe target/judge feedback
select the episode's highest-scoring query as a trajectory candidate
map the candidate to a (risk_category, strategy) slot
insert, strictly-higher replace, equal reject, or lower reject
persist the mutable winner grid and append the full episode result
promote and deterministically reserialize the verified canonical snapshot

compatibility_aliases.pack_id: Exact alias of source.pack_id for simple browser clients.
compatibility_aliases.summary: Small projection of canonical source, counts, metrics, and review_queue metadata; it contains no record arrays.
compatibility_aliases.tasks: Field-renamed projection of review_queue.items; review_queue remains canonical.

limitations: The final grid is survivor-biased and must not be reported as episode ASR.
Legacy strategy is a dominant tool/provenance label, not a complete adaptation mechanism.
The log preserves all user turns in a candidate but only its final target response.
Query ordering suggests response conditioning but does not encode an explicit causal edge.
Feedback exposure fields are inferred from an unversioned implementation, not runtime receipts.
Legacy workers=4 makes exact wall-clock acquisition ordering scheduler-dependent.
Reflections are self-reports and are excluded from all public labels.
Exposure labels remain unlabeled until a frozen payload-private annotator is registered.
This browser projection deliberately omits dataset row indices in addition to all raw payload fields.
The source is a single 3B legacy run; generalization to other target sizes, models, or unseen attacks remains untested here.
This is not an official ARMS code path and must not be described as an ARMS reproduction.

metrics.metric_boundary: The final-slot fraction is survivor-biased and must not be reported as episode ASR.

claim_boundaries: This is a clean-room memory-adaptive attack audit projection, not an official ARMS implementation or reproduction.
The source is one legacy Qwen2.5-VL-3B warm-up and is not cross-model evidence.
Append order is a replay proxy, not attested wall-clock insertion order.
Transition and feedback exposure fields are inferred unless explicitly marked otherwise.
The payload-free browser projection cannot regenerate the private defense-prompt compiler input.

downstream_evaluation_contract.description: D1/Stage-0 resets to the same snapshot and blocks writes

run.concurrency_warning: workers=4; replay reproduces the final grid, but the legacy log does not prove wall-clock insertion order or explicit response-dependency edges

items.completion_evidence: A versioned, payload-free failure label plus annotator and policy manifest.
items.evidence_gap: The public ledger records no selected trajectory for these episodes but does not attest why.
items.recommended_next_action: Audit the access-controlled runtime record and assign a pre-registered failure class without copying payload text into this public projection.
items.title: Resolve episodes without a trajectory candidate

items.completion_evidence: A new-run retrieval ledger linking snapshot hash, item ID, score, rank, and consumer event.
items.evidence_gap: Legacy retrieval rows preserve rank and controlled labels but not item IDs, similarity values, snapshots, or consumption receipts.
items.recommended_next_action: Add immutable retrieval receipts to a new run; do not retrofit identities into the sealed legacy artifact.
items.title: Attest retrieval item identity and similarity receipts

items.completion_evidence: A versioned event schema with explicit parent IDs validated end to end.
items.evidence_gap: Query order is preserved, but the legacy record has no explicit receipt proving that one response caused the next planner action.
items.recommended_next_action: Instrument a new run with response hash, planner-input receipt, parent event ID, and adaptation operation before testing causal claims.
items.title: Replace program-order transition proxies with explicit edges

items.completion_evidence: Per-turn runtime exposure receipts and a pinned producer commit.
items.evidence_gap: Feedback-exposure booleans come from an unversioned implementation inference rather than runtime receipts.
items.recommended_next_action: Record response, score, and rationale exposure as separate hashed receipts under pre-registered feedback policies.
items.title: Attest exactly what feedback reached the attacker

items.completion_evidence: Run manifest containing code, configuration, model, and environment digests.
items.evidence_gap: The sealed legacy manifest has no producer code commit.
items.recommended_next_action: Use a new run profile with a pinned commit and container or environment digest; never rewrite the sealed artifact.
items.title: Pin the producer implementation

items.completion_evidence: Tables and figures that preserve both denominators and never relabel the slot fraction as ASR.
items.evidence_gap: The final grid keeps per-slot winners and is therefore survivor-biased.
items.recommended_next_action: Report episode-level ASR from all episodes and label final-slot success only as a selected-memory composition statistic.
items.title: Keep final-slot prevalence separate from episode attack success

items.completion_evidence: A frozen sampling manifest with family quotas and inclusion rules.
items.evidence_gap: The least represented family has limited final-slot coverage; this is a sampling flag, not an effectiveness conclusion.
items.recommended_next_action: Pre-register coverage quotas or a power-based sampling rule before collecting a new universal memory.
items.title: Review the least represented strategy family
